title: Alpine mall
content: Dreams about a giant mall next to alpine mountains. My mall is next to mountains. Reminds me of Switzerland. I've never been to Switzerland. There's a water park, the mall, fish could swim around in the air instead of water, an airport near by, hotel. I can never afford the rooms so I break in to stay. It's extreme beautiful and airy in the rooms, bright big windows where I can see the alpine mountains and quaint town at the bottom of the valley. In the dream I'm always on a very shot vacation and I feel like I don't have time to enjoy any of the attractions cause I'm in such a rush trying to experience it all.
